gaps: The tin can itself is explicitly excluded: 'The inventory includes all processes from washing, blanching to filling, but without the tincan itself.'
No heat/steam input is listed even though blanching needs it - the whole energy demand is booked as electricity.
No waste water output and no direct emissions are given (unlike the neighbouring drying dataset, which books a Water emission).
No transport of the legumes to the cannery.
